name: Return to the Blasted Lands
summary: Galvan the Ancient sends you back to the Blasted Lands with your newly forged weapons. The Fallen Hero of the Horde waits there, ready to ask if you will face Razelikh.

sections.title: A Call to Redemption
sections.body: Galvan the Ancient says your hour of redemption has come. Your enchanted weapons are complete, so you carry them back to the Blasted Lands to find the Fallen Hero of the Horde. The ghostly warrior asks if you are ready to face Razelikh and his minions.

faq.q: Who sends you back to the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient forges your weapons, then sends you back with them to the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Whom are you sent to meet in the Blasted Lands?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: You are sent to meet the Fallen Hero of the Horde again. He awaits your return and will reveal your final confrontation.
This follows Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry, where your specialized weapons were completed.

faq.q: Who is the enemy awaiting you in the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: The Fallen Hero of the Horde asks if you are ready to face Razelikh and his minions.
